rounds.description: Deep, resonant male baritone, 1940s Hollywood matinee idol, over-enunciated and self-important, slight Western drawl, confident and vain.
Older female, Mid-Atlantic accent, grand theatrical stage actress, imperious and dramatic, crisp diction, capable of operatic shrieks.
Young male, fast and high-pitched, nervous and eager, frequent voice cracks, breathy, apologetic.
Middle-aged male film director shouting through a megaphone, passionate and theatrical.

Middle-aged male film director shouting through a megaphone, passionate and theatrical. Adjustments: different take: a booming veteran director with a raspy, hoarse shout, impatient and passionate, slightly more gravelly and bigger than before.

rounds.description: Female, dry, deadpan, efficient stage manager, talks over a radio.

Female, dry, deadpan, efficient stage manager, talks over a radio. Adjustments: much more sarcasm, extremely deadpan and dry, flat monotone delivery, bone-dry wit, world-weary and unimpressed, barely hiding contempt, low energy.

Female, dry, deadpan, efficient stage manager, talks over a radio. Adjustments: much more sarcasm, extremely deadpan and dry, flat monotone delivery, bone-dry wit, world-weary and unimpressed, barely hiding contempt, low energy; even more sarcastic and openly annoyed, dripping with irritation, deadpan and dry, flat monotone with exasperated sighs, a smoker's dry rasp, sardonic and fed up, like she has said this a thousand times, minimal emotion.

Female, dry, deadpan, efficient stage manager, talks over a radio. Adjustments: much more sarcasm, extremely deadpan and dry, flat monotone delivery, bone-dry wit, world-weary and unimpressed, barely hiding contempt, low energy; even more sarcastic and openly annoyed, dripping with irritation, deadpan and dry, flat monotone with exasperated sighs, a smoker's dry rasp, sardonic and fed up, like she has said this a thousand times, minimal emotion; try a different voice type: a younger, sharp-tongued woman in her thirties, nasal and bored, sarcastic with a barely audible eye-roll in every line, flat and dry, passive-aggressive stage manager who is done with everyone, speaking tersely into a radio.

Female, dry, deadpan, efficient stage manager, talks over a radio. Adjustments: a sharp-tongued woman in her thirties, nasal and bored, passive-aggressive stage manager done with everyone, speaking tersely into a radio; highly expressive and emotionally rich despite the deadpan: audible exasperation, eye-rolling sarcasm, clipped irritated sighs, pointed pauses, sing-song mockery, dramatic pitch swings on key words, a real personality with attitude, never flat or robotic; lots of vocal character: biting sarcasm, sudden bursts of annoyance and weary resignation, comedic timing.
